push.title: L 1-6 vs feshar fc | You: 7.9
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 7.9 is above the line for a forward. Let's go hunting for the extra half point.

THE GOOD
+ 5 shots at feshar fc's goal. You were knocking on that door like you were selling encyclopedias.
+ 2 key passes. Selfless as a church potluck, and twice as filling.
+ Completed passes 35, up from your usual 23. You can build a whole match on that.
+ Missed tackles 1, down from your usual 3. Remember that the next time you doubt yourself.
+ 6 goals conceded counted for +0.2. That's the hidden value in your game.

THE BAD
- 3 of 5 shots on target. Fundamentals: The best shots come from the middle of the box. Work it there before you pull the trigger. One rep at a time.
- Their best forward posted 10.0 to your 7.9. Let's call that a lesson and not a trend.
- This loss burned our last chance in Division 3 and set up a relegation match. That's on all of us, not just you, and all of us fix it.
- Tackles attempted 1, down from your usual 3. We'll drill that till it's boring.
- We shipped 6 goals to feshar fc and lost by 5. That stings the whole locker room, and it should.

Quick drill: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide.

PhogsToffees, you already know this, but I'll say it anyway: The ball doesn't know your rating. Neither should your attitude.

Next match, we go again. - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 1-6 vs feshar fc | You: 7.6
push.body:
BellyTb1, a 7.6. Like a good casserole, it's not fancy, but everybody's glad it showed up.

THE GOOD
+ 31 passes (up from your usual 20). You kept the engine turning over.
+ 1 key pass. Making your teammates look good is the most generous thing in football.
+ You & PhogsToffees clicked. That partnership's got more legs than a centipede in a sack race.
+ Tackle success 33%, up from your usual 20%. If the rest of the night was a storm, that was the lighthouse.
+ 3rd straight match at 7.5 match rating. That doesn't happen by accident.

THE BAD
- 0 goals from 2 on target. Next match: Finesse it to the far post from an angle. One-on-one, go low and hard. Feet first, then flair.
- This loss burned our last chance in Division 3 and set up a relegation match. We'll talk about it as a group, then leave it behind us.
- We shipped 6 goals to feshar fc and lost by 5. That's the scoreboard being honest with us.
- Your 4th straight loss. That's the bill for the little mistakes, and we all chipped in.
- 6 goals conceded docked 0.2. Small leak, easy patch.

Training ground: We're hitting the target, so now aim for the corners. Keepers love a shot down the middle.

Hey BellyTb1, hold onto this one: If plan A doesn't work, the alphabet has 25 more letters.

We're building something here. - Coach Lasso
